user.title: Set up WeHeat OpenTherm
user.description: Choose the sensors for the calculation. Only room and outdoor temperature are required. Afterwards, set your heating curve via Configure (the default curve is an estimate) and flash the ESPHome bridge from the README.

data_description.room_temp_sensor: Temperature of the room that matters most for heating, usually the living room. Not near a window, stove or in the sun. Use the same sensor in the ESPHome bridge.
data_description.outdoor_temp_sensor: Preferably a stable source: your own sensor in the shade, or the weather entity's temperature via a template. Not the WeHeat's own outdoor sensor, which fluctuates while the compressor runs. If this sensor is unavailable, the integration stops calculating and the ESP keeps the last setpoint.
data_description.weather_entity: For wind and sun corrections. Must provide an hourly forecast, such as Met.no (default in HA), OpenWeatherMap or KNMI; Buienradar only has a daily forecast. If Forecast.Solar is set up, the sun correction uses it.
data_description.price_sensor: Dynamic electricity price, e.g. Zonneplan, Frank Energie (current all-in price), Tibber, Nordpool or ENTSO-e. Without a price list the price correction stays 0.
data_description.setpoint_entity: Usually leave empty: the ESPHome bridge reads this integration's supply setpoint sensor. Only fill in if you also want the setpoint in an input_number.
data_description.heatpump_status_sensor: The status sensor from the WeHeat integration, e.g. sensor.<heat pump>_heat_pump. With it the curve does not learn from sun or hot water, and the thermostat shows whether the pump is heating.

error.no_hourly_forecast: This weather entity has no hourly forecast. Choose e.g. Met.no or leave the field empty.

init.title: Temperature settings
init.description: Adjust temperature limits and correction factors.

data_description.target_temp: Target temperature for room compensation calculation.
data_description.t_min: The calculated setpoint will never go below this value.
data_description.t_max: The calculated setpoint will never exceed this value.
data_description.compensation_factor: Higher value = stronger reaction to temperature deviation (default 2.0).
data_description.forecast_hours: Hours ahead to evaluate wind chill and sun (1–6 hours).
data_description.max_price_correction: Maximum correction in °C due to energy prices.

curve.title: Heating curve configuration
curve.description: Define 5 (outdoor temperature → supply temperature) pairs. Points are automatically sorted by outdoor temperature. As a guide for underfloor heating: about 33 °C at −10 °C outdoors and 21 °C at 15 °C. Too warm or too cold? Shift all points; the adaptive curve then does the fine-tuning.

extras.title: Extra sensors
extras.description: Optional integrations with other HA sensors.

data_description.heatpump_status_sensor: The status sensor from the WeHeat integration, e.g. sensor.<heat pump>_heat_pump. Recommended: with it the curve does not learn from sun or hot water, and the thermostat shows whether the pump is heating. Leave empty to disable.

advanced.title: Advanced corrections
advanced.description: Fine-tune the price and sun corrections for your home.

data.cheap_preheat_delta: Preheat bonus when electricity is cheap

data_description.cheap_preheat_delta: Higher = more preheating at low prices. Lower for light buildings with little thermal mass.
data_description.expensive_saving_delta: Higher = stronger savings at high prices. Watch room comfort.
data_description.sun_sunny: Higher for large south-facing windows, lower for north or little glazing.
